mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 6 months compresses equity discount rates, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with declining FEDFUNDS over 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 5.0% for two consecutive months, it signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for two months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as economic activity slows.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with both HOUST and RSAFS declining, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.5%), rising payroll employment (PAYEMS growth > 0.5% monthly) signals labor market tightness that fuels inflation, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the past 6 months indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with rising INDPRO over 6 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: When residential construction permits (HOUST) fall below 1600 thousand units, it signals housing market contraction that reduces consumer wealth and spending, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with HOUST < 1600, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous increases in unemployment rate (UNRATE) and declines in payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicate labor market deterioration, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with rising UNRATE and falling PAYEMS, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.

mechanism_narrative: In a high inflation regime (CPIAUCSL > 2.5% annualized), rising federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases equity discount rates, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods meeting the trigger condition, or Rank IC for the interaction falls below 0.02 over 3-year windows.
